values: Use this workbook to update one area at a time.
Enter CPC lines on the CPC tab. The pattern column is required for CPC lines.
Enter radar developmental lines on R-Dev and data developmental lines on D-Dev. Their type and section are set by the worksheet name.
Enter one bid line per row. Use RDO for regular days off and the published shift code for every workday.
Fatigue Group, AWS, and Flex may be left blank. For new lines they default to C, No, and Yes.
In the Admin Console, choose the bid year and area, upload this workbook, review the preview, and import.
